changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation to note CLI v1.2+ is required for localize/variations/edit features.
- Added a new section detailing how to refine existing visuals using the `canvora localize` command instead of regenerating from scratch.
- Clarified that edits, localization, and variations cost 10 credits per visual and may require certain plan features.
- No impact to main generation commands or core functionality.
summary: Create on-brand visuals (social posts, carousels, decks, ads, documents) from any text, URL, or PDF via Canvora. 100+ formats, native generation in 150+ languages, per-client brand kits. Use when the user asks to create, generate, or design visual content for social media, marketing, or presentation
